title: One to Five, By the Road Urdu Did Not Borrow
label: ch:ur-count-five
canDo: I can say, hear, read and write the Urdu numbers one to five, name the English cousin of each, and say why none of them came in from Persian.

payoff.summary: Five numbers, five Indo-European roots, no new letter and no Persian borrowing -- retrieved shuffled rather than recited.
